weather_report:
Subiaco moves through early afternoon under a bright, open sky, the sun assertive and the air clear, with only a few shy clouds beginning to gather. Expect the light to stay generous through mid to late afternoon, shifting from mostly sunny to a gentle scatter of cloud toward early evening. The UV is punchy now and will ease as the day leans toward dusk; the day itself feels cheerful and clean-edged, the kind that sharpens colors and shadows and makes everything look freshly painted.

Dress light and breathable, add sunglasses and a brimmed hat, and don sunscreen if you’re out for long. It’s a fine time to run a couple of errands on foot, to slip into a quiet café and read while the sun is at its boldest, or to browse a bookshop before a late-afternoon amble when the light softens and the breeze grows companionable. If you’ve washing to dry or a small task in the garden, the weather will be kind, though the shade will be kinder.
